reuse.why: Introduces one isNonWorkingDay predicate and extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend, then routes every weekend check (including schedule-template's direct date-fns isWeekend) through them.

duplication.why: No new copies of the rule; holidays are threaded by hand into each existing call, and the parallel daily-skip/move branches in getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange remain as before.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts with the other weekend helpers; the type gains the field and parseRecurDate carries it.

scope.why: Only weekend-handling helpers, their callers and the type are touched.

maintainability.why: Single clear definition of a non-working day; names still say 'weekend' and callers must remember to pass holidays explicitly.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend sites (getNextDate, first/lastWeekdayOccurrence, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template) use isNonWorkingDay/getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

one_place.where: isNonWorkingDay and getDateWithSkippedWeekend in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts, used by every weekend-handling path in shared/schedules.ts, server/schedules/app.ts and server/budget/schedule-template.ts.
